package handler

import (
	db "example.com/idle-sim-practice/db"
	playerentity "example.com/idle-sim-practice/game/entities/player"
	idle "example.com/idle-sim-practice/game/idlesim"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
	"time"
)

type IIdlePlayerEntity interface {
	entity.IThreadSafeEntity
	Dao() *db.PlayerDao
	TimerComp() *playerentity.TimerComponent
}

// Rules 来自服务端捕获的 configdata Snapshot；已有存档不因重试或新配置改变经济。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerIdleInit(p IIdlePlayerEntity, now int64, rules idle.Rules) (idle.View, error) {
	if p.Dao().GetState() != "" {
		s, err := idle.Decode(p.Dao().GetState())
		return s.View(), err
	}
	s, err := idle.NewState(now, rules)
	if err != nil {
		return idle.View{}, err
	}
	if err := saveIdle(p, s); err != nil {
		return idle.View{}, err
	}
	return s.View(), nil
}

// PlayerID 取鉴权会话，now 取服务端时钟；命令不能上报工时、产出、余额或离线长度。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerIdleCommand(p IIdlePlayerEntity, c idle.Command, now int64) (idle.Receipt, error) {
	s, err := idle.Decode(p.Dao().GetState())
	if err != nil {
		return idle.Receipt{}, err
	}
	before := len(s.Receipts)
	r, err := s.Apply(c, now)
	if err != nil {
		return r, err
	}
	if len(s.Receipts) != before {
		if err := saveIdle(p, s); err != nil {
			return idle.Receipt{}, err
		}
	}
	return r, nil
}

//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerIdleView(p IIdlePlayerEntity) (idle.View, error) {
	s, err := idle.Decode(p.Dao().GetState())
	return s.View(), err
}

// 结果未知保持原 Seq 查询；不得为领取或取消生成新身份盲重试。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerIdleReceipt(p IIdlePlayerEntity, seq uint64) (idle.Receipt, error) {
	s, err := idle.Decode(p.Dao().GetState())
	if err != nil {
		return idle.Receipt{}, err
	}
	if seq == 0 || seq > uint64(len(s.Receipts)) {
		return idle.Receipt{}, idle.ErrRule
	}
	return s.Receipts[seq-1], nil
}
func saveIdle(p IIdlePlayerEntity, s idle.State) error {
	if old := p.Dao().GetWakeTimer(); old != 0 {
		p.TimerComp().RemoveTimer(old)
		p.Dao().SetWakeTimer(0)
	}
	p.Dao().SetState(s.Encode())
	if deadline := s.NextDeadline(); deadline != 0 {
		id := p.TimerComp().NewTimerAt(time.UnixMilli(deadline), playerentity.TimerProduction, deadline, 0, nil)
		if id == 0 {
			return idle.ErrRule
		}
		p.Dao().SetWakeTimer(id)
	}
	return nil
}
